**Goal `path-literals-follow-up`: Stages 1 to 5 are on disk. Stage 5's feature proofs for `Core\Path::thisFile` and `thisDir` are written, and Stage 6 is next.** Stage 1's floor is goal `plain-comments`'s list.

Both members now have `about.md`, three examples with blessed `.out` files, one attack each and one bench each. The perf figures for `thisFile`, `thisDir` and the stale `fromCwd` were recorded over the `Core\Path` group (see the perf commit). The `thisFile` attack found a compiler panic: `Core\Path::$m()` (a `Core` class with a `::$name` side) reached `nvs-ir` with nothing recorded. `nvs-types` now reports `E0309` for it, and `tests/conformance/lang/a-static-property-of-a-core-class-does-not-compile.nvst` pins that.

Stage 4's example 01 (`docs/examples/core/Path/fromCwd/01-a-file-name-from-the-command-line.nvs`) is still only half done: it does not read the file. The example runner starts every example from the repository root with no arguments, and a read there needs an `fs.read` grant that the root does not give.

`bun nv proofs --id` reads the roster from a stale `nvs` unless you pass `--nvs` (playbook, Tooling).

ADR slot left: Stage 6, so check `docs/decisions/` right before claiming it (0250 or higher).

items.text: **The ADR for `'X' as class<T>`** (`rule:types/class-reference`, which it `modifies`; Stage 6's slot, 0250 or higher, so check `docs/decisions/` first). The compile-time check that `X::class as class<T>` already runs is at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/operators.rs:128`. A plain string literal gets the same check and reuses its codes.

**The literal loads its class through `autoload` while compiling** — test `a_class_literal_conversion_loads_its_class` in `nvs-hir`, beside `crates/nvs-hir/src/autoload.rs:1`. The `nvs-types` test is `a_class_literal_conversion_names_a_class_that_can_be_loaded`, and the case is `tests/conformance/lang/class-literal-conversion-is-decided-while-compiling.nvst`.

**Completion offers every class `autoload` can load that is a `T`** — test `completion_in_a_class_literal_offers_every_class_autoload_can_load`, at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:679` (`class_names`; its doc says what it offers).

backlog: Stage 4's example 01 does not read its file (`docs/examples/core/Path/fromCwd/01-a-file-name-from-the-command-line.nvs`, `rule:programs/path-literals-resolve-from-their-file`). It can if the example runner reads an `nvs.toml` beside the example that grants `fs.read`. Not checked whether it does.
`Core\X::$m()` reads in PHP as a call by a name held in a variable. Novis reports `E0309`, and no rule names that refusal: `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md` could carry the row.
